container.note: Image is ${IMAGE_NAME}:${DEMO_VERSION}-accountingservice (docker-compose.yml:22). The compose block (lines 21-45) has no healthcheck key, so no container health check is configured for this service; it is a consumer and exposes no port. restart: unless-stopped (line 33), memory limit 120M (line 32).

replicas.note: No deploy.replicas or scale key in the block (docker-compose.yml:21-45); a fixed container_name admits one container. Replica count is not stated explicitly.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: OTLP over HTTP; OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST=otelcol and OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP=4318 in .env:27 and .env:29. Instrumentation is OpenTelemetry.AutoInstrumentation 1.8.0 (AccountingService.csproj:20) launched through ./instrument.sh (Dockerfile:32). No export interval is set in these files (library default, not in these files). Harness override compose.candidate-postures.yml:22-24 sets OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER from ${OTEL_CANDIDATE_ACCOUNTINGSERVICE_EXPORTER}, unresolved in these files; whether the exporter is otlp or none per posture is not stated here.

group.note: EnableAutoCommit = true and AutoOffsetReset.Earliest at Consumer.cs:80-81.

broker.note: Bootstrap address read from env KAFKA_SERVICE_ADDR (Consumer.cs:22); passed through in docker-compose.yml:35.

coordinator.note: The only broker this consumer is configured against (BootstrapServers = servers, Consumer.cs:78). The group coordinator role of the broker is Kafka protocol behaviour, not stated in these files.

type.note: Consumer sets GroupId (Consumer.cs:77) so the group protocol applies; type is the library/protocol behaviour, not stated in these files.

mechanism.note: library default, not in these files: the ConsumerConfig block (Consumer.cs:75-82) sets GroupId, BootstrapServers, AutoOffsetReset and EnableAutoCommit only; no SessionTimeoutMs, HeartbeatIntervalMs or MaxPollIntervalMs.

monitors.note: Group member tracked by the group coordinator.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.note: library default, not in these files (librdkafka heartbeat.interval.ms 3000; Confluent.Kafka 2.5.3 per AccountingService.csproj:12). Config block Consumer.cs:75.

failureTimeoutSeconds.note: library default, not in these files (librdkafka session.timeout.ms 45000). Config block Consumer.cs:75.

heartbeatThreadIndependentOfWork.note: library behaviour, not in these files: librdkafka sends heartbeats from its own background thread; the service only calls _consumer.Consume() in a loop (Consumer.cs:41), and max.poll.interval.ms (library default, not in these files) still bounds time between Consume calls. Cleanup interval is a broker setting, not stated in these files.
